about: Full-tree `filter: blob:none` checkouts leave out the paths below: the job reads none of them, and each checkout otherwise downloads their blobs (about 470 MB of media and QA evidence under cmux-next-ios/verify/). actions/checkout runs before any repository file exists, so a composite action cannot hold the patterns; this file does, and tests/test_ci_checkout_lean.py keeps every listed step's `sparse-checkout` equal to it and fails on a new full-tree blob:none checkout that is in neither list.

backend.yml.deploy-staging: works in backend/; worker-release.ts globs backend/apps/api only
backend.yml.deploy-development: works in backend/; worker-release.ts globs backend/apps/api only

ci-compile-attribution.yml.analyze: main_compile_attribution.py reads git objects (rev-list, diff-tree, show), never the worktree

ci.yml.changes: routing reads names, trees and the CI scripts and workflows it opens (scripts/ci, .github, tests); build_input_fingerprint.py hashes `git ls-tree -r`, which lists verify/ from the tree; the change-area walk's `git grep` no longer sees verify/ files, which run no CI helper, so they no longer send a helper change to every area

cmux-next-batch.yml.batch: next_batch.py merges in a worktree that inherits the sparse patterns; regenerate() adds with `git add -A -- .`, which skips skip-worktree paths; touches_tree reads scripts/cmux-next/cmux-tui-tree-inputs.txt

cmux-vm.yml.migrate-production: works in scripts/cmux-next/release; the rails read workers/cmux-vm/migrations, the lock and schema-requirements.ts from git objects (git archive) and git grep a release tag, never cmux-next-ios/verify/

cmux-next-car-guards.yml.plan: focused_tests.plan reads Package.swift files, webviews/ and tests/; verify/ holds none of them
cmux-next-car-guards.yml.mac: fast-tier-cache-key.sh hashes `git ls-files -s` of Package.swift/Package.resolved (index, unchanged); the Swift packages built here do not include verify/

cmux-next-generated-catch-up.yml.catch-up: the generated patterns and regenerate-web-bundles.sh cover webviews and resources only; a conflict under verify/ is written out and left to the author as before

cmux-next-pr-autofix.yml.action-exports: web-bundle-key.py inputs are webviews, schemas and CmuxNext xcstrings; nothing there imports cmux-next-ios
cmux-next-pr-autofix.yml.repair: repairs are scoped to Swift sources, Packages, cmux-tui and webviews; the patch diff and add are limited to the changed paths computed before read-tree

cmux-next-web.yml.web-bisect: web-bisect-probe.sh checks out --force (keeps the patterns) and builds webviews; run-webviews-tests.sh lists tests from cwd=webviews

cmux-tui-testbox-warmup.yml.cmux-tui-rust: builds cmux-tui; the source-mtimes helper walks only files that exist

gallery-advisory.yml.capture: gallery tools read webviews/src and webviews/dev-server; the base worktree builds webviews only

nightly.yml.build-sign-notarize-nightly: signs the prepared app from the artifact; from the build ref it runs scripts/ and reads the entitlements, ghostty-next (its own submodule init) and the notices inputs, never cmux-next-ios/verify/
nightly.yml.publish-nightly: runs .publish-tooling's scripts in the build checkout, which reads scripts/ (verify_remote_daemon_release.py, cmux-next/release-notes.py, release_thanks.py) and release-notes/, never cmux-next-ios/verify/

nightly-next-train.yml.drive: object-level git only (merge-tree --write-tree, commit-tree, cat-file, diff-tree, push)

r2-binaries-prune.yml.prune: git rev-list/log on three pin files and R2 listings

whats-new-gallery.yml.render: reads release-notes/next/highlights, scripts/ and webviews/ only, here and in a worktree at an earlier commit with the same patterns

cloud-vm-image-roll.yml.plan: auto-roll.ts plan reads git history and images/cmux-vm (the lock, pin-cmux-tui.ts), never cmux-next-ios/verify/

cmux-next-car-guards.yml.linux: runs tests/test_ci_fleet_rule_lints.py, whose allowlist names cmux-next-ios/verify/ scripts; with them absent its git grep skips them and it reports 20 stale entries

ci-guard-attribution.yml.analyze: runs the CI guards (the fleet rule lints among them) in scratch worktrees that would inherit the patterns; it checks out main, which has no cmux-next-ios/, so leaving it out saves nothing
